remarks: Welcome to 30 Stuart Ave #4! Not your typical 2 bedroom 1.5 bath rental. Half duplex/townhouse style which includes full size washer/dryer, assigned parking, central air & personal basement for storage! Open concept with high ceilings. Over 2,000 sq ft of living space just on levels 1 & 2. Lower level unfinished but includes 600+ sq ft for bonus room/storage/office. Main level includes large living room, dining area, EIK, half bathroom, laundry room & MORE! New flooring throughout levels 1 & 2. 2ND FL includes 2 SPACIOUS bedrooms, a full bathroom, NEW recessed lighting & plenty of closet space. Natural gas for heat/hot water, insulated, thermopane windows & central air keep the utilities LOW! Tenants receive 2 assigned parking spaces - visitors park on Stuart. Tenants must have good credit, proof of income & references.
